summary: First full E2E test of Hariram's Pure Cow Ghee Phase 1. Backend: 31/31 pytest passing (all config, products, shipping, OTP mock, orders, newsletter, last-address). Frontend: full user flow verified — landing (header/nav/hero/benefits/products), cart add+qty+subtotal, checkout address → OTP (123456) → mock payment → order confirmation with HR-prefixed order number, repeat-customer address autofill on phone blur, mobile hamburger menu.

issues: Console warning: Missing aria-describedby / Description on Radix DialogContent (a11y minor)
React console warning: Invalid DOM property fetchpriority (should be fetchPriority) — minor React warning

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add DialogTitle+Description or aria-describedby to CartDrawer/Sheet component to silence Radix a11y warning.
(Optional/minor) Fix fetchpriority -> fetchPriority (or use lowercase via {...props}) to remove React DOM warning.
critical_code_review_comments: OTP rate-limit boundary is off-by-one: verify_otp reads pre-increment attempts, so it takes 6 failed attempts (not 5) to trigger 429. Cosmetic; still returns 429 after several failures.
No inventory / stock check on order creation — acceptable for Phase 1 mocked flow, but flag before adding real payment.
server.py mixes routing + business logic + models in a single 354-line file; still under 700-line threshold but consider splitting into routers/ per resource before Phase 2 growth.
seed_data_creation: Test-only phones (9876500001/2/99) created OTP & order docs in DB; can be cleaned by prefix filter if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_hariram_api.py (31 tests, all pass). Frontend flow: add HG500 to cart → cart drawer → checkout → fill address (state is a <select>, use select_option, city/pincode fields are inputs) → phone blur triggers last-address lookup → Continue → OTP step (send is auto; enter 123456 → verify) → Payment step → Pay Now → /order/HR* confirmation with data-testid confirmation-order-number. Shipping recalculates on debounce after pincode fill+blur.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs found. All features in the review request work end-to-end.
